quarterly_data.signal: 10-K supplier disclosure: Analog Devices sources more than half of its wafer requirements annually from third-party wafer fabrication foundries such as Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC), with the remainder sourced internally at its fabs in Wilmington, Massachusetts; Camas, Washington; Beaverton, Oregon; and Limerick, Ireland. It also makes extensive use of third-party subcontractors for assembly and testing, alongside its own assembly, wafer sort and test facility in Penang, Malaysia (held for sale) and wafer sort and test facilities in the Philippines and Thailand, and says tensions across the Taiwan Strait could disrupt TSMC's operations and its ability to manufacture certain products.
quarterly_data.figure: more than half of wafer requirements from third-party foundries such as TSMC

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K: net additions to property, plant and equipment were $533.6 million in fiscal 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: $533.6 million net additions to property, plant and equipment (fiscal 2025)
